title: Public text acquisition lacks response deadline and byte bound
evidence: adapters.ts jinaReaderFetch previously awaited fetch and res.text without timeout/stream cap; a stalled or oversized public source can hold worker resources indefinitely.
reproductions: never-resolving transport is bounded even if it ignores abort
stalled response body is cancelled on deadline
chunked body above byte cap without content-length is refused
fix_direction: Apply 10000ms wall-clock deadline and 1000000-byte streaming cap, abort/cancel and safe errors; preserve existing URL guard.
